segments.text: You're paying Sunno 10 bucks a month when there's an open- source model that runs on your own GPU and sounds just as good. AEP 1.5 generates commercial
quality full songs in under two seconds on an A100, under 10 seconds on a 3090.
Runs on 4 GB VRAM minimum. 10-minute songs, batch generation, 50 languages, covers, stem separation, metadata
